settings.heading: Beginner fishing kits, made simple
settings.text: Ketto Outdoors sells beginner fishing kits. Each kit is a box of tackle picked to work together for one kind of fishing: bass, catfish, or your very first fish from a pond or dock. Every kit comes with step-by-step setup instructions and a how-to guide for each piece. Bring your own rod and reel, and you are ready to fish.

settings.heading: STOP GUESSING. START FISHING.
settings.text: One kit. Nothing to figure out.
